tasks.question: 按 sale_id 升序查询销售表前40条完整记录
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT * FROM sales_records ORDER BY sale_id LIMIT 40

tasks.question: 统计药品表的药品总数，列名为 total
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM drugs

tasks.question: 按销售区域统计销售金额合计，列名为 region 和 amount，按区域升序排列
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT region, SUM(total_amount) AS amount FROM sales_records GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

tasks.question: 查询库存量最大的前5条库存，返回 inventory_id、drug_id、quantity_on_hand，按 quantity_on_hand 降序，再按 inventory_id 升序
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT inventory_id, drug_id, quantity_on_hand FROM inventory ORDER BY quantity_on_hand DESC, inventory_id ASC LIMIT 5

tasks.question: 查询治疗领域 therapeutic_area 为心血管的药品，返回 drug_id、generic_name，按 drug_id 升序
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT drug_id, generic_name FROM drugs WHERE therapeutic_area = '心血管' ORDER BY drug_id

tasks.question: 按 sale_id 升序返回前10条销售的 sale_id、generic_name、quantity_sold，需要关联药品表
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT s.sale_id, d.generic_name, s.quantity_sold FROM sales_records AS s JOIN drugs AS d ON s.drug_id = d.drug_id ORDER BY s.sale_id LIMIT 10

tasks.question: 统计每种药品的销售数量合计，仅保留合计大于100的药品，返回 drug_id、total_quantity，按 drug_id 升序
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT drug_id, SUM(quantity_sold) AS total_quantity FROM sales_records GROUP BY drug_id HAVING SUM(quantity_sold) > 100 ORDER BY drug_id

tasks.question: 查询 sale_id 小于0的销售，返回 sale_id、drug_id，按 sale_id 升序；没有数据时返回空结果
tasks.reference_sql: SELECT sale_id, drug_id FROM sales_records WHERE sale_id < 0 ORDER BY sale_id
